envelope.outer_copy_scope: Every ZIP member is hashed; every authority file copied both outside and inside the evidence tar is compared. Extra outer upload copies are not additional native attempts.

limits: Retained discovery records and bytes establish equality for recorded indexes at these boundaries; they do not prove absence of transient changes or independently rediscover unrecorded Git administration paths.
Successful frozen assertions support refusals involving forged in-memory objects; those mutated objects and caught exceptions are not separately serialized.
Three earlier selection-expression source variants retain manifests/raw reports but only the final fixture head archive; their raw source bytes cannot be reauthenticated from that final archive.

Installed venv/wheel trees are excluded from the evidence tar. This audits retained original-controller identities, inventories, artifact hashes and raw metadata, without rereading remote installed files.
This admission gate does not establish prospective task success, comparative benefit, native G2-G6, or hostile-process nonbypassability.
Wheel and venv trees are excluded by the workflow. Download receipts, installed-file hashes, and their frozen fingerprints are checked; excluded package bytes are not independently rehashed.
The legacy profile has no retained full installed-file list: its package-files fingerprint cannot be reconstructed offline from the 22-name installed inventory.
This stdlib audit compares exact raw dependency metadata and frozen closure receipts; it does not execute an independent PEP 440/508 resolver or replay release ranking.
Project JSON request bodies are not versioned in the source archive; request ledger hashes are bound but their excluded response bodies cannot be rehashed here.

scope: Offline parsing and hashing only; no artifact code execution, Git, network, native, or collection experiments.
